model.projectMap: A digest-bound description of existing modules, ownership, mutability, paths, test seams, and an explicit extension, basename, or path-context language signal. It may remain caller-declared or arrive inside a fresh read-only Hand observation.
model.projectMapObservation: A separately authorized read-only Hand receipt proving current matching paths and byte digests inside one explicit workspace root while retaining caller-declared semantic roles.
model.changeIntent: An explicit software direction, code-role kind, ownership signals, public seams, dependencies, and verifier targets.
model.placementDecision: A deterministic extend, create, or hold result bound to the language grammar and project map.
model.authorizedExecution: A later Hand may apply a fresh plan only after checking the named preconditions and returning receipts.
